summary: Lifecore Biomedical filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary, Lifecore Biomedical, LLC, entered Amendment No. 3 to its Amended and Restated Contract Manufacturing Agreement with Alcon Research, LLC, effective Nov. 1, 2026. The amendment extends the initial term from Dec. 31, 2031 to Dec. 31, 2034, with automatic 24-month renewals, and sets Alcon's minimum purchase obligations through 2034. Lifecore accepts a non-compete from Nov. 1, 2026 on certain competing products. No price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; this is a routine commercial contract amendment, not a special situation.
